ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central, low-intensity (black) contiguous geometric region originating at the notch and peduncle, flanked by expansive high-intensity (white) lateral fields. Low-intensity vertical striations are mapped across both lobes, originating from the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge topography characterized by high-frequency peaks and valleys (3-15 pixel amplitude), with significant distortion at the distal tips caused by macro-scale biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping outward from the median notch, terminating in steeply upturned, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, calcified high-contrast structures (barnacles) localized on the outer margins and tips; scattered individual circular orange-brown spots on the white fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel and vertical low-intensity linear marks (rake-like scratches) breaking the white pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral calcified protrusions on trailing edges and tips; a unique figure-eight shaped high-contrast mark is visible in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A significant portion of the lower-central fluke surface near the peduncle is occluded by high-intensity white noise corresponding to water spray and splash artifacts.
